categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu CORPRO Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in integrated circuit design, Beidou satellite navigation applications, smart city construction and operation services, and machine perception and intelligent products. The company offers a comprehensive solution ecosystem from intelligent chips to intelligent terminals and intelligent applications and services, focusing on specific industries and AI integration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs fabless integrated circuit design, outsourcing wafer manufacturing and packaging. Core technologies include mixed-signal ICs, RF direct sampling chips, 3G-SDI transceiver chips, software-defined radio (SDR), frequency synthesizers, clock chips, and high-precision positioning modules. It emphasizes high reliability and stability under extreme conditions, system-on-chip (SoC) design, 3D heterogeneous integration, wafer-level packaging, and AI-driven automated layout and routing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large domestic enterprises and public institutions in sectors such as satellite navigation, broadband communication, video image processing, and security monitoring. The company serves specific industries requiring high-performance, reliable chips and intelligent solutions, including energy, hydrology, transportation, and public safety. It also targets emerging markets like autonomous driving, low-altitude economy, and AIoT applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are primarily concentrated within China, with significant revenue generated from regions including Southwest China, North China, East China, Central China, South China, Northeast China, and Northwest China. It has subsidiaries and registered offices mainly in Chengdu and Beijing, with some international presence through a Hong Kong subsidiary.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chengdu CORPRO Technology operates upstream in the integrated circuit industry as a fabless design company. It focuses on IC design, partial testing, and sales, while wafer fabrication, packaging, and assembly are outsourced to third-party manufacturers. The company also provides end-to-end intelligent solutions, moving towards system-level integration and intelligent application services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in AI integration with specific industries, advancing technologies such as AI+ chip design, high-speed SerDes, image processing, SDR+FPGA/MCU, and edge computing. It invests heavily in R&D (26.74% of revenue in 2024), focusing on next-generation Beidou navigation chips, intelligent perception modules, and unmanned platforms. The strategic goal is to become a leading 'specific industry + AI' enterprise and to build a comprehensive intelligent system ecosystem.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of integrated circuits, Beidou navigation modules and terminals, smart city construction and operation services, and machine perception and intelligent products. The company also earns income from design services, government subsidies, and investment returns. Sales are mostly contract-based with milestone and progress payments, including prepayments and post-delivery settlements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a high-barrier industry dominated globally by giants like Texas Instruments, Analog Devices, Skyworks, and Infineon. Domestically, the market is fragmented with many small players. Chengdu CORPRO positions itself as a core domestic supplier in satellite navigation, broadband communication, video processing, and interface chips, focusing on high reliability and specialized applications to differentiate from mass-market consumer electronics suppliers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 797 million, a 6.44% decrease from 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 40 million, down 44.91%. Despite revenue decline, operating cash flow improved significantly. The company has total assets of around RMB 2.9 billion and equity of RMB 1.78 billion, showing moderate growth in asset base. R&D investment increased steadily, reflecting a focus on innovation-driven growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chengdu CORPRO emphasizes high reliability, stability, and long lifecycle of its integrated circuits designed for extreme environments in specific industries. Its products simplify system solutions and enhance intelligent capabilities, supported by a strong R&D foundation and comprehensive service from chip design to intelligent terminals and applications. The company leverages deep industry expertise, extensive patent portfolio, and close customer relationships to provide differentiated, high-performance, and customized intelligent solutions.
